text.title: Families in new Moscow districts, banner on the app home page
text.attention: Tired of queuing for groceries after work?
text.interest: Pickers scan stock live, so the list you order is the list you get
text.desire: Groceries at your door in 2 hours; 98% on time in June
text.action: Order before 20:00 for same-evening delivery; first delivery free
text.satisfaction: Order on time, or the delivery is refunded; we check it weekly
text.offer: Tired of queues? Order before 20:00 and get groceries in 2 hours, free the first time
text.risk: The 98% figure covers June only; evening slots may sell out
text.check: Banner click-through and share of first orders on time, every 2 weeks
text.decision: Run the banner in 2 districts from 1 October; decide after 4 weeks
